description: Rule-based detection of unusual readings in 30-minute room data (default: last 24 h, at most 14 days): implausible values or jumps, constant readings, missing data, rapid drops at a constant setpoint, sustained deviation from the setpoint. Each finding has severity, confidence, evidence and an explanation; findings are observations, not diagnoses.

from.description: Range start, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-01-15 or 2026-01-15T07:30). Without an offset it is read in the home time zone.

home_id.description: Home ID from netatmo_list_homes. Optional when the account has a single home.

max_anomalies.description: Maximum findings returned, most severe first (default 30)

period.description: Named period in the home time zone. Alternative to from/to.

room_name.description: Limit to one room (default: all rooms)

to.description: Range end, ISO 8601. Defaults to now when "from" is given.

name: netatmo_detect_anomalies

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the home
